rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: The guidance supports a collaborative approach to preventing, diagnosing and managing tuberculosis in secure settings.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: It is intended for both healthcare and non-healthcare teams working in secure settings.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: Local TB services, NHS commissioners, health protection teams and TB control boards are included among the intended users.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: The covered settings include adult prisons and young offender institutions.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: Approved premises and immigration removal centres are also within scope.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: The guidance addresses detecting and managing tuberculosis cases.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: It includes notification routes and management of incidents and outbreaks.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: The guidance includes measures intended to prevent new cases among residents and staff.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: TB risk depends on infectiousness, ventilation, contact duration, setting, symptoms, vulnerability, testing and treatment timing.

rows.source: UKHSA tuberculosis prevention and control in secure settings
rows.verified: Secure-setting TB evidence is case-, contact-, facility-, population- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: Whooping cough is a chest infection caused by pertussis bacteria.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: The infection can cause prolonged and forceful coughing fits.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: The cough can continue for weeks or months.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: People of any age can develop whooping cough.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: Pertussis is particularly dangerous for babies.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: Babies younger than 6 months can have difficulty breathing when infected.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: Vaccination is the principal way to protect babies, children and pregnant people from serious illness.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: UKHSA publishes national guidance for healthcare professionals on the public-health management of pertussis.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: Pertussis risk depends on age, vaccination, exposure intensity, household or care setting, symptom timing and contact vulnerability.

rows.source: UKHSA pertussis prevention and public-health management
rows.verified: Pertussis evidence is case-, contact-, vaccination-, setting- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
